headline: How to Pick the First Thing When Everything Is Late: Six Steps
sub: Take just the person and date piles, and go down this list once.
items: Cross out anything with a real consequence that has already started or lands in the next few days.
Pick the one that would change something for another person tomorrow.
If two tie, pick the one with fewer steps.
Write the first physical step, something a person watching could see.
Do that step. Only that step.
Copy the rest of the list onto one page or one screen, and put it out of sight.

headline: How to Organize a Bag of Unopened Mail: Four Stacks, Nothing Decided Yet
sub: Each item goes in one stack and gets one word of next step. Nothing is done yet.
items: Act: a person is waiting on you, or a date is printed on it.
Keep: a reference or record you'll need again, like a claim letter or statement.
Ask someone: you can't tell what it is or what it wants.
Bin or shred: junk, or anything with an account number on it that you're sure is finished.
